ModMetaData.name: Rim Prototype - 生物质核心
ModMetaData.author: Hjx
ModMetaData.description: 添加了一个新的神器(需要先触发巨石) (可以在虚空石碑附近找到) 小人使用后，会获得一个“生物质”状态条 以及三种武器形态：利爪、利刃、护盾 除此之外，没有其他获取方式，并且只能同时存在一个。 --------------------------------------------------------------------------- New Artifact Added (The artifact was found near the VoidMonolith.) Upon use by the pawn, a "Biomass" status bar is gained. Three weapon forms are unlocked: Claws, Blade, and Shield. There are no other ways to obtain it, and only one can exist at a time.
